name: Subscription Usage
author: CodeOfficer (fork of Rob Zolkos)
description: How much of each AI subscription you have used (Claude, Codex, Gemini, optionally Suno) in the Omarchy bar, with reset countdowns and pace.

barWidget.description: Claude, Codex, Gemini and Suno plan usage at a glance.

schema.label: Show Claude
schema.description: Claude Pro/Max limits, read with the sign-in Claude Code keeps.

schema.label: Show Codex
schema.description: ChatGPT plan Codex limits, read with the sign-in the Codex CLI keeps.

schema.label: Show Gemini
schema.description: Google AI Pro/Ultra Gemini quota, read with the sign-in the Antigravity CLI (agy) keeps.

schema.label: Show Suno
schema.description: Suno Pro/Premier monthly credits. Off by default; after turning it on, choose Sign in in the panel to sign in to suno.com in a browser window of the widget's own.

schema.label: Bar detail
schema.description: Show only the percent used in the bar, or the time until reset too. The panel always shows both.

schema.label: Pace tolerance (points)
schema.description: How far a window can drift from its prorated share before it turns red: over it for Claude, Codex and Gemini, under it (credits left to expire) for Suno.
